name: Semantic-NeRF
definition: The first work to integrate semantic information into NeRF, utilizing RGB images alongside corresponding semantic labels to train the NeRF network, incorporating an additional semantic output to enhance semantic understanding of scenes.
summary: Semantic-NeRF synthesizes semantic labels for novel views by extending NeRF with a dedicated semantic branch, distinguishing itself as the first method to integrate semantic information directly into the NeRF framework.
